description: Authoritative strict crossing-policy audit (fslw/SPEC.md §4 = abcd/SPEC.md §2.1 with clearance 0.080 mm) of the 16 frozen height-plane experiments and the 8 Phase-11 sensitivity runs of the FSLW R=40 mm / 30 um dual-height experiment. Single-layer 2D plane geometry; cross-plane XY-projected crossings are not same-layer conflicts, so each plane is audited independently.
policy: strict (lim = clearance - 1e-7; R=40 mm / clearance=0.080 mm for the primary matrix)

notes.failed_identities: A failed identity is a connection for which the router generated no legal fixed-R=40 candidate (no_candidate_generated / no_legal_candidate). It is a geometric feasibility limit, NOT a rejected or illegal geometry and NOT a violation; only routed primitives are geometrically audited.
notes.cross_plane: Plane z1 (CSV row 1, opposite) and plane z2 (CSV row 2, adjacent) are independent 2D routing problems; XY-projected crossings between planes are not same-layer conflicts and are never counted as violations.
notes.histogram_consistency: crossing_angle_histogram sums equal crossing_count for every run
notes.d56: d56_passed_count == routed_count for every run (all routed primitives are legal D56 R=40 geometry)
notes.plane_metadata: plane height z is metadata; primitives are pure 2D layer 0
notes.process_resolution: process parameters resolved from each routes.json 'process' block (R/gap/clearance) and recorded per run
notes.crosscheck: router D56Index(width, gap, crossing_policy='strict') vs independent validator, each broad-phase route pair isolated; validator is authoritative. For the two clearance=0.175 sensitivity configs (O, R) the router-side band-edge solver returns a larger h* than the validator on the exactly-0.175 mm parallel plateau (false-position stagnation); verdicts, crossing counts and window counts still agree exactly (mismatch=0, 0 invalid pairs) and the authoritative validator finds 0 violations. Primary clearance=0.080 matrix matches to <1e-5 mm.
